# aisearchmastery.com

> AI Search Mastery is a static hub for work on AI search visibility. It holds the MASTERY-AI Framework, an open methodology of 149 atomic factors across 8 pillars, plus guides and articles about how AI search engines such as ChatGPT, Perplexity and Claude find and cite content. The site sells nothing and runs no service. Two tools it used to run, AImpactScanner and LLM.txt Mastery, were switched off in August 2026 and their source code is now public under the MIT licence.

Last updated 2026-09-13.

## Blog & Articles

- [You Can Rank #1 and Still Be Invisible to AI](https://aisearchmastery.com/blog/fundamentals/rank-1-still-invisible/): Why a high search ranking no longer guarantees visibility when AI systems answer queries directly, and what to do about it.
- [93% of AI Searches Never Reach a Website](https://aisearchmastery.com/blog/fundamentals/93-percent-of-ai-searches-never-reach-your-site/): What zero-click AI answers mean for site traffic, and why being in the source pool matters more than the click.
- [Is AI Stealing Your Traffic? Understanding AI's Impact on Search](https://aisearchmastery.com/blog/fundamentals/is-ai-stealing-your-traffic/): How AI search engines answer questions without sending a visit, and how to adapt.
- [Your SaaS Is Invisible to ChatGPT: Here's Why](https://aisearchmastery.com/blog/fundamentals/your-saas-is-invisible-to-chatgpt/): A scan of SaaS products showing the structural and technical signals that decide whether AI can describe a product at all.
- [If Google Can't Find You, AI Search Won't Either](https://aisearchmastery.com/blog/fundamentals/if-google-cant-find-you/): Why foundational SEO is a precondition for AI visibility, mapped onto the MASTERY-AI Framework.
- [The Uncomfortable Truth About llms.txt Generators](https://aisearchmastery.com/blog/fundamentals/uncomfortable-truth-llmstxt-generators/): Four llms.txt generators run against the same site, and why their outputs disagree so much.
- [The $200,000 Problem Nobody's Talking About](https://aisearchmastery.com/blog/fundamentals/the-200000-problem/): The cost of advertising on AI platforms, and why earning a recommendation is the realistic route for a small business.
- [Which llms.txt Tool Actually Works? We Benchmarked 14](https://aisearchmastery.com/blog/industry-updates/which-llmstxt-tool-actually-works/): A four-step evaluation of 14 tools, with scores and what each one does and does not do.
- [AI Search Arena: How Our Open Benchmark Methodology Works](https://aisearchmastery.com/blog/industry-updates/ai-search-benchmark-open-methodology/): The evaluation framework and scoring dimensions designed for the AI Search Arena benchmark, which never ran a cycle.
- [Why Independent AI Search Benchmarks Matter](https://aisearchmastery.com/blog/industry-updates/ai-benchmark-platform-why-it-matters/): Why self-reported tool results are hard to compare, and what an independent benchmark needs to measure. The benchmark it announces never ran.
- [Building AImpactScanner: From Concept to AI Search Readiness Tool](https://aisearchmastery.com/blog/industry-updates/building-aimpactscanner/): A build log of the AImpactScanner tool, which has since been retired.
- [AImpactScanner Analysed Every Website: React, Vue, SPAs and More](https://aisearchmastery.com/blog/industry-updates/aimpactscanner-analyzes-every-website/): How full JavaScript rendering was added to the AImpactScanner tool, which has since been retired.

## Additional Resources

- [How AI Search Decides What to Recommend](https://aisearchmastery.com/): Home page. What the site is and where the framework, the articles and the retired tools now sit.
- [MASTERY-AI Framework](https://aisearchmastery.com/framework): The open methodology: 8 pillars and 149 atomic factors, published so anyone can inspect, question and build on it.
- [Retired tools](https://aisearchmastery.com/products): A record of AImpactScanner and LLM.txt Mastery, switched off in August 2026, with links to their public source code.
- [AI Search Insights, the blog](https://aisearchmastery.com/blog): Guides and industry updates on AI search visibility.
- [About](https://aisearchmastery.com/about): Jamie Watters, why the framework was written, and how the work got here.
- [Contact](https://aisearchmastery.com/contact): A contact form and an email address. Replies within 48 hours.
- [Privacy Policy](https://aisearchmastery.com/privacy): What the contact form collects and how the cookieless analytics work.
- [Terms of Service](https://aisearchmastery.com/terms): The terms governing use of the website.
